intel_intelligence.definition: The ability to reason, to solve a problem that is not written down, and to adapt when the situation changes.
intel_intelligence.example: Intelligence is what lets her find her way through a procedure she has never seen before.

pump_dry_run.definition: The pump turning without water around it, so that the motor has nothing to cool it.
pump_dry_run.example: A dry run heats the motor of a submersible pump.
